brief:
Israel is deliberately attacking women and girls in Gaza as part of a strategy to prevent births and destroy the Palestinian population, Amnesty International alleged. The rights group characterized the pattern of strikes on civilians as a systematic effort "to destroy life" in the territory.

Amnesty's assessment, reported by Al Jazeera English, identifies attacks on women and girls as central to what it describes as a broader campaign against Palestinians in Gaza. The organization did not specify a timeframe for the alleged pattern or provide a detailed breakdown of incidents reviewed in reaching its conclusion.
dek: Israel seeking 'to prevent births' and destroy Palestinians in Gaza by targeting women and girls, rights group says.
title: Amnesty says Israel targets women, girls to prevent Palestinian births
